site_number: Brentford Football and Sports Club Ltd.
description: Erection of additional seating at Brook End and additional canopy cover to Ealing Road terrace, installation of additional turnstile and concourse, access and egress providing community facilities behind New Road stand, improvement of toilets, refreshment and disabled facilities to site.  (AMENDMENTS TO NORTH STAND (NEW ROAD))
site_name: Brentford Football and Sports Club Ltd.
decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - Prior to the occupation of the North Stand development hereby permitted, the applicant shall submit a detailed management plan to be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this plan shall contain details of the following, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority,

?	The exact nature of each proposed use of the premises.
?	The hours of operation of each use,
?	The capacity of the venue.
?	The number of staff.
?	Traffic management measures for each use.

Upon approval of the submitted management plan, the proposed scheme shall be implemented in full and remain so unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - No amplified or other music shall be played in the community floorspace premises unless agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 7 - No fans, louvers, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the local planning authority.

Condition : 8 - No demolition of construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0900am to 17:30 on Mondays to Friday and 0900am to 13:00pm on Saturdays. None shall take place on Sundays and public hours without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 9 - Details of bin storage shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA, and the scheme then implemented prior to the first use of the extensions hereby permitted.
Condition : 10 - Details of cycle racks shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA, and the scheme then implemented prior to the first use of the extensions hereby permitted.

Condition : 11 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the north stand and community facility shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 12 - Notwithstanding the detail shown on 128/AL(0)162 Rev B, the use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any plant necessary and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 13 - The scheme of ventilation approved under condition 11 shall be fully implemented before the use is commenced.

Condition : 14 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 15 - The scheme approved under condition 13 shall be fully implemented before the facilities or kiosks serving hot food are open to customers.

Condition : 16 - The facilities provided at first floor of the north stand extension shall not be occupied until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.
